I.A No. 2435 of 2025.
06/08.05.2025
Mrs. Shweta Singh, learned A.P.P has submitted at the Bar, a copy of the objection application.
Let it be kept on record.

Heard Mr. Jitesh Kumar, learned counsel for the appellant and Mrs. Shweta Singh, learned A.P.P.
This application has been preferred by the appellant for grant of bail to him during the pendency of this appeal.
The appellant has been convicted for the offences under Sections 323, 341, 342, 506 and 376(2)(n)
IPC and has been sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment for ten years along with a fine of Rs.
10,000/- under Section 376(2)(n) IPC.

It has been alleged that the appellant had an intimate relationship with the victim and on the threat of making a video viral, which was prepared by the appellant, she was sexually exploited.
Submission has been advanced by learned counsel for the appellant that the victim is aged about 30 years, but in her cross-examination as P.W.1, she has categorically stated that she was in love with the appellant and wanted to solemnize marriage with the appellant.
This fact has also been corroborated by P.W.2, who happens to be sister of the appellant.
Learned A.P.P. has opposed the prayer for bail of the appellant.
